inventory.visualPurpose: Complement cascade — the three-pathway convergence diagram
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: A vector pathway map: three activation columns (Classic with Ag-Ab complex/Antigen; Lectin with microbial-surface Sugar moiety; Alternative with Microbial surface + FactorB (Bb) + Properdin or factor D + C3b amplification loop) converging through C3 convertase (MBL-MASP or C1 complex feeding C4/C2) and C5 convertase (C5, C5b) to the Membrane attack complex (MAC: C5b, C6, C7, C8, polymerized C9) and Cell lysis/Cytolysis; side branches: C3a and C5a stimulate mast-cell degranulation → Histamine increases endothelial permeability (Inflamation); C5a-mediated neutrophil chemotaxis; and the Opsonization inset (C3b on Microbe engaging the Complement receptor on a Phagocyte).

notes: Census: pure vector page (zero rasters). The cascade diagram is redrawn as ONE original KYP registry visual (complement-cascade-map) with all printed labels accounted for (25 label quotes verified). Verbatim ACT/functions/opsonin/inhibitor text is the note's table block.
